build_crowd_sourced_annotation_model: build a CrowdSourcedAnnotation Stan model for inferring true labels from noisy crowd-sourced annotations
format_data_to_stan: format an xarray dataset into a Stan-compatible dictionary with 1-based labels and labelers
extract_data_from_stan: extract Stan inference samples into an xarray Dataset with prev and confusion_matrix parameters
get_pars: get the list of required inference parameters prev and confusion_matrix from the model
get_code: get the Stan model code string with dirichlet priors and categorical likelihood for crowd annotation
